LanguageData.TMM.Restaurant.AreasHelp: Create allowed areas with the normal area tool, then assign dining seats and food stock separately. Both areas are required. Dining seats must also be allowed to the guest.
LanguageData.TMM.Restaurant.OpenHelp: Closing cancels unserved orders without charging guests.
LanguageData.TMM.Restaurant.MenuHelp: Offer one prepared meal type at this counter. Guests' dietary restrictions and actual ingredients are checked.
LanguageData.TMM.Restaurant.PriceHelp: Percentage of market value, rounded up to whole silver. Accepted orders retain their price. Hospitality's free-food setting makes restaurant meals free too.
